reviews.text:
The consultant is really rude & outspoken and rough with the animals,
There's no consideration for the pets or their owners

Came to them for a second opinion with my dog's ear infection. Stayed because the vet was brilliant, helpful and supportive. The women on reception were friendly and helpful and rooms were clean which was not the case at my last vets! Also family run business and prices are lower than the corporately owned vets.

I chose to register my cats at Oaks Vets after being unhappy with how my late cat was cared for at another surgery. They have been excellent from the start, promptly booking my cats in for a spay and neuter in less than a week during covid. Something I was very grateful for as they were a boy and girl and at an age where it should have already been done by the rescue! I recently had a health scare with one of my cats and was concerned that I should have taken him to the emergency vets overnight, and that a product I had used had made him unwell. The vet was lovely and reassuring, checked the product over for me and explained what could be done if he didn't improve. The medication did him the world of good and he was back to himself as soon as he got home.  Unlike my previous vets I often see the same staff, which I think makes a big difference in ensuring your pets get consistently good care.
I have an elderly cat who needed dental treatment, have seen both Sam and Simon and have been enormously impressed with the service.

It was a sad time for us as we had taken a much loved pet to be euthenoised and the staff were very lovely and understanding. had to have an urgent appointment and they did.
the price was very reasonable as other vet quotes where 4 to 5 dearer. I highly recommend

Really don’t recommend Rebecca, but unfortunelly she is the boss for this vet.

After argue so many times. We decide to opt out for her egos
Different prices for different people. I’d never go there

I'm not sure which vet this was at the practice (I hadn't had him before) but he clipped my poor bunny's nail too short and made her bleed, which I believe is very substandard for a vet (a nurse had to take over and I've never even clipped her nail too short myself!). This was very stressful for her and I believe it contributed to her falling into early stages of GI Stasis the poor girl. He also only checked one side of her mouth in the check up and gave up pretty quickly on the other one - they might not like it (and rarely do without a bit of pushback), but it is important, and it came across as a very 'oh it doesn't matter' level of service. He should definitely stay away from rabbit care as he clearly doesn't have the experience for it.

Nevertheless, for the care following this, I'd like to share a particular shoutout to Vet Nicki. Despite not being specialised in rabbit care, she has very rabbit-savvy knowledge and a really lovely approach & customer service, always making me feel like I'm in good hands. I believe she gave all of the treatment and recommendations a rabbit specialist vet would have done. She talked me through how to manage the condition over the phone for the weekend and generally gave that reassurance that pet parents sometimes need. Now my bun seems to be on the mend and getting back to her usual mischievous self. The admin team also filled out the insurance claim details extremely quick with no delay. Thank you hero Vet Nicki & admin team! 🐰🐾

I’d love to give 5 stars to Rebecca — she’s an excellent vet. Unfortunately, the experience at the front desk ruined it. The woman on reception was cold, robotic, and kept repeating “you must pick your pet up on time” while my cat was having surgery. I would never leave my baby behind. Customers deserve kindness, not attitude.

Can’t recommend this vets enough!!
I registered my cat only yesterday and was booked in straight away for today, as he was previously under vets for pets in selly oak. My cat was seen by Rebecca the owner of the practice (top dog as I called her 😉) and she was fantastic. She knew exactly how to handle my cat who has been traumatised these past two weeks,from being seen at the previous vet’s and still getting no answers as to what was wrong with him. 😢
Within an hour of leaving the practice she called me with the answers I had been looking for and told me what was wrong with my poor cat, she gave me all the options for him going forward and explained things so well. All the staff there seem so lovely and friendly. Thank you once again.

I have been a customer for over 35 years however recently the attitude here has changed and I won’t be going back after being let down several times this year and the final straw was being unable to change an appointment due to an emergency the receptionist was very rude and extremely unhelpful.

I I am a Consultant within the NHS, where respect and clear communication are fundamental. Unfortunately, this standard has not been reflected in my recent interactions with a particular vet, Rebecca.

This is now the second consecutive appointment where I have experienced her manner as condescending, dismissive, and unprofessional and belittling. On both occasions, I felt belittled rather than supported.

During the most recent consultation, I felt her tone had become patronising and said so directly, asking her to stop. Her response was, “I will stop when you start listening to me.” I calmly clarified that I was listening. This exchange was uncomfortable and unnecessary, and it contributed to an already tense situation.

I also had concerns about the way my dog was handled, which felt overly forceful. When my dog became distressed and resistant, this was attributed to poor training, with comments such as him being a “naughty dog,” rather than adapting the approach to manage his anxiety.

Additionally, she raised her voice regarding the dog’s collar, stating in a threatening manner that it was a legal requirement. This was not explained in a calm or professional way.

I would like to emphasise that I have had positive experiences with other members of the team, who have been consistently caring and professional. However, my experiences with this vet have been sufficiently negative that I no longer feel comfortable continuing care at this practice.

Having since read other reviews describing similar experiences, it appears this may not be an isolated incident.

I am extremely disappointed and will be seeking care elsewhere.
